strings.EMMA es un prototipo de concurso, no un: EMMA is a competition prototype, not a flight CDSS, and it has not been evaluated against this document. What it does: it compares each reading with the crew member's own baseline, flags deviations and trends, and recommends checks and countermeasures from a library written as data; a person decides. It does not identify medical conditions or treat them. It works offline and without cloud services. Its rules and thresholds are not clinically proven decision-making models: what has been measured is in compliance/external-validation.md.

strings.EMMA no es un modelo probabilístico de p: EMMA is not a probabilistic planning model and does not use MEDPRAT, IMPACT or the IMM. It does not estimate the frequency or consequences of medical events, or the probability of evacuation or loss of crew, and it does not choose a mission's medical resources. Those tools answer, before flight, what risk a mission carries; EMMA watches each crew member during the flight against their own baseline and proposes checks, and a person decides. It does not duplicate those estimates or replace them.

strings.EMMA no lee telemetría de ningún sistema: EMMA reads no telemetry from any habitat system and does not model a spacecraft's thermal control: the status of a system is declared by a person on the console, signed in the ledger. Its systems vocabulary (data/habitat_systems.json) is a design choice and says so. What was read places it as follows: OCHMO-TB-002 puts temperature, humidity, CO2 and trace contaminants under air revitalization, and oxygen under pressure control, whereas EMMA divides them differently; power, communications and lighting are not part of the ECLSS, and fire detection, which is, is not in the vocabulary. The ATCS removes heat from equipment; what EMMA calls «thermal and humidity control» is, in these sources, part of cabin air. analysis/context.py cites the ATCS FDIR as inspiration: EMMA does not reproduce it, it only ranks common-cause hypotheses, and a person decides.
strings.La cadena «SENSE → COMPARE → DETECT ANOM: The chain «SENSE → COMPARE → DETECT ANOMALY → ISOLATE → RESPOND → RECOVER» from the team's ideation conversation: searched for in the ATCS overview, it does not appear in those words. It is the team's reading; the document says FDIR, telemetry monitoring and notification of the crew and the ground.
strings.Que «el estado del vehículo modifica el: That «the state of the vehicle modifies the human state» (knowledge base, §6) is not said by the ATCS overview: it is the lesson the team draws. What the knowledge base does say about it —water loops inside, ammonia and radiators outside, two loops and up to 70 kW— is in the sentences above.
strings.El resumen del ATCS describe la estación: The ATCS overview describes the station of 2006, under assembly: how it is today has not been looked up.
strings.Los resúmenes técnicos relacionados que: The related technical briefs listed by OCHMO-TB-002 (OCHMO-TB-003, -004, -008, -015, -027 and -042) and their references have not been read.
strings.Una partición de los sistemas de un hábi: A partition of the systems of an exploration habitat (Gateway, Artemis) with which to replace EMMA's: not searched for.
strings.Lo que piden las frases de este bloque,: What the sentences of this block ask for, point by point, and what EMMA does with each, with the file where it lives. «Covers» means EMMA has a piece that does it; not that it has been evaluated against the document or tested in flight. «Partly», that it does some of what is asked, and the row says what is missing; «no», that it does not do it. Sentences that describe the problem or the document without asking for anything have no row. Inventory: it plays no part in the crew's status.
strings.Señala desviaciones de cada lectura fren: It flags deviations of each reading from the crew member's own baseline and sustained trends. It does not detect medical events as such: it says that something changed, not what it is.
strings.No diagnostica: informa y recomienda com: It does not identify conditions: it informs and recommends checks (invariant 7 of CLAUDE.md). The draft from the local model in interpret/ does not enter the analysis or any alert.
strings.No trata ni administra terapia: recomien: It does not treat or give therapy: it recommends checks and countermeasures, and a person decides.
strings.Propone contramedidas de una biblioteca: It proposes countermeasures from a library written as data, each with its evidence. Whether they prevent anything has not been measured.
strings.Cada fuente entra por ingest/ y sale com: Each source comes in through ingest/ and goes out as a FHIR R4 Observation: changing wearables does not touch the analysis. It has not been tested with flight hardware.
strings.Las observaciones son FHIR R4; cada códi: Observations are FHIR R4; each LOINC code is verified against its official record and the rest use EMMA's own system, which says why (invariant 1). Exchange with another medical system has not been tested.
strings.No se conecta a ningún sistema médico: r: It does not connect to any medical system: it receives readings through its API and what a person declares on the console.
strings.No lleva inventario del botiquín. Hay un: It keeps no inventory of the medical kit. There is a closed vocabulary of resources and what a person declares available or not, placed next to each recommendation; no quantities, no shortages and no predicted needs.
strings.No lee ningún ordenador ni sistema de la: It reads no computer or system of the spacecraft: the status of a habitat system is declared by a person, signed in the ledger, and the habitat telemetry in the demonstration is simulated.
strings.Lee wearables (BLE y exportaciones de Ap: It reads wearables (BLE and exports from Apple Health and Google Fit), the PVT, DICOM ultrasound studies, scanned reports with local OCR, manual entry and the simulator, and all those observations go through the same chained ledger. Separately, it reads the JPL ephemerides and DONKI.
strings.Funciona sin red como modo nominal y la: It works offline as its nominal mode and the onboard console does not wait for the ground; risk is scaled with light time. Whether that makes a crew self-reliant has not been evaluated.
strings.Un corte del enlace se declara en la con: A link outage is declared on the console and the ground sees how far its data reached; offline, everything keeps working on board.
strings.El retardo sale de las efemérides de JPL: The delay comes from the JPL ephemerides: the ground console sees the data with it applied and risk is scaled with light time.
strings.El simulador genera varios tripulantes (: The simulator generates several crew members (four by default in an environmental scenario) and the Inspiration4 replica carries the four of that mission.
strings.Cada protocolo de ecografía recuerda al: Each ultrasound protocol reminds the operator how the measurement is taken and what invalidates it, and a badly set-up measurement is rejected with the reason. It is not training, and outside ultrasound there is nothing.
strings.No lleva mensajes: la consola de Tierra: It carries no messages: the ground console reads the same data with the delay applied, but there is no channel with medical personnel or with family.
strings.La consola de Tierra solo lee: no hay ví: The ground console is read-only: there is no path for guidance from the ground to enter what the crew sees.
strings.El análisis no usa aprendizaje automátic: The analysis uses no machine learning: it is versioned rules and statistics. The only model, the local draft in interpret/, is not trained.
strings.No hay vía de actualización en vuelo: el: There is no in-flight update path: the desktop package is built on the ground. Each verdict carries the version of the rules that produced it.
strings.Sus reglas y umbrales no son modelos de: Its rules and thresholds are not clinically proven decision-making models. What has been measured is the false alarm rate in healthy people and the sensitivity to deteriorations injected into that same physiology, on Earth; not clinical validity, and not in flight.
strings.Corre en un portátil: la aplicación de e: It runs on a laptop: the desktop application starts the frozen backend locally. The heavy, optional parts (TotalSegmentator, Whisper) are kept apart and are declared unavailable if missing. It has not been measured on flight hardware.
strings.No usa servicios en la nube: el modelo d: It uses no cloud services: the interpret/ model is local and every outbound connection goes through an allowlist with an offline mode.
strings.Sin red es el modo nominal de misión, no: Offline is the nominal mission mode, not a degraded one, and the tests run with the network cut.
strings.No se ha revisado frente a ninguna polít: It has not been reviewed against any NASA security policy. What it has (a chained and signed ledger, a server on loopback only) has not been evaluated for that purpose.
strings.compliance/state-of-the-art.md sitúa a E: compliance/state-of-the-art.md places EMMA among the systems read; it is a reading done for a competition, not the assessment of a roadmap.
strings.FHIR R4 y códigos LOINC verificados, con: FHIR R4 and verified LOINC codes, with a justified system of its own for the rest. Exchange with another system has not been tested.
strings.Vigila constantes y sueño frente a la lí: It watches vital signs and sleep against the personal baseline, and performance with the PVT. What has been measured is with Earth physiology (compliance/external-validation.md), not in flight.
strings.Lee el pulso y los intervalos R-R por BL: It reads heart rate and R-R intervals over BLE (standard heart rate profile) and exports from Apple Health and Google Fit. No flight biosensor.
strings.Cada observación se anexa a un registro: Each observation is appended to a chained and signed ledger and to an append-only store; the evidence lives in a registry of records, each with what was read and when.
strings.Junta en el estado de cada tripulante co: It brings together vital signs, environment, habitat and radiation in each crew member's status, and ranks common-cause hypotheses across crew members. It does not fuse sensor signals.
strings.A propósito: reglas deterministas y esta: On purpose: deterministic rules and statistics on the baseline, which a person can review. No machine learning in the analysis.
strings.Normaliza cada lectura a FHIR R4 con su: It normalizes each reading to FHIR R4 with its code and unit and runs it through the data quality check.
strings.Proyecta las derivas a un horizonte fijo: It projects drifts to a fixed horizon, labeled as predicted, and afterwards compares what was projected with what was measured. It does not predict medical events or their probability.
strings.Las recomendaciones citan su evidencia c: Recommendations cite their evidence with the date it was read and its grade. There is no treatment: a person decides.
